answer: Reaching eligibility takes 72 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. The lagoon register is checked at draw time, marble lists the eligible set, and mesa seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 72 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Slashing removes 16 percent at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
